formalObservation.Composition:
A vertically oriented composition containing several distinct figures and structures.

Major elements:

- large profile-like figure occupying the left side
- central elevated structure
- smaller vertically oriented figure at right
- large rectangular structure occupying the lower-middle portion
- circular forms at its lower edge
- broad irregular horizontal ground form at the bottom
formalObservation.Primary Forms:
- Large left-facing profile figure
- Central vessel / structure
- Smaller right-hand figure
- Rectangular lower structure
- Irregular ground form
formalObservation.Visible Anatomical Features:
Large left figure:

- eye
- nose / facial projection
- mouth
- triangular tooth-like marks
- head / body contour

Central structure:

- multiple circular internal forms
- vertically extended upper section

Right-hand figure:

- circular head-like form
- vertically elongated body
- curved appendages
formalObservation.Structural Elements:
- Large rectangular lower structure
- Vertical supports
- Circular lower units
- Central elevated form
- Curved lateral structures
- Bottom horizontal ground form
formalObservation.Repeated Forms:
- Circular forms
- Eyes / eye-like forms
- Triangular tooth-like marks
- Vertical supports
- Parallel hatching
formalObservation.Mark-Making:
- dense horizontal and diagonal hatching
- thick contour lines
- filled charcoal passages
- repeated linear texture
- overlapping outlines
- lighter unworked paper
formalObservation.Formal Language:
- Profile and frontal configurations coexist.
- Multiple independent forms share one pictorial field.
- Rectilinear and organic contours are juxtaposed.
- Circular forms recur within both anatomical and structural contexts.
- Hatching varies in density according to the individual form.
- A horizontal ground element establishes a lower compositional boundary.
